confidentialite.title: Privacy Policy
confidentialite.s1_p1: The controller of personal data collected via the cyna.dev platform is CYNA DEV, a SAS with share capital of €10,000, whose registered office is located at 123 Avenue de la Sécurité, 75001 Paris, France.
confidentialite.s2_intro: As part of our services, we collect the following data:
confidentialite.s2_li1: Identification data: first name, last name, email address, company name.
confidentialite.s2_li2: Connection data: IP address, access logs, authentication data (2FA).
confidentialite.s2_li3: Billing data: billing address, order and subscription history. Card data is processed directly by Stripe and is never stored on our servers.
confidentialite.s2_li4: Usage data: pages visited, interactions with the platform, preferences.
confidentialite.s3_intro: Your data is collected for the following purposes:
confidentialite.s3_li1: Account management and secure authentication (legal basis: performance of the contract).
confidentialite.s3_li2: Order processing and billing (legal basis: performance of the contract).
confidentialite.s3_li3: Provision and improvement of our cybersecurity services (legal basis: legitimate interest).
confidentialite.s3_li4: Sending transactional communications (confirmations, invoices) (legal basis: performance of the contract).
confidentialite.s3_li5: Compliance with our legal obligations (legal basis: legal obligation).
confidentialite.s4_li1: Account data: duration of the contractual relationship + 3 years.
confidentialite.s4_li4: Support data: 3 years from ticket closure.
confidentialite.s5_p1: Your data may be shared with the following subcontractors, strictly within the scope of providing the service:
confidentialite.s5_li3: Railway Corp. – backend and data hosting.
confidentialite.s5_p2: We do not sell, rent or share your data with third parties for commercial purposes. Any transfer outside the EU is governed by appropriate safeguards (European Commission standard contractual clauses).
confidentialite.s6_intro: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the French Data Protection Act, you have the following rights:
confidentialite.s6_li1: Right of access: obtain a copy of your personal data.
confidentialite.s6_li2: Right to rectification: correct inaccurate data.
confidentialite.s6_li3: Right to erasure: request deletion of your data.
confidentialite.s6_li4: Right to data portability: receive your data in a structured format (available from your customer account).
confidentialite.s6_li5: Right to object: object to certain processing.
confidentialite.s6_li6: Right to restriction: restrict the processing of your data.
confidentialite.s6_rights_request: To exercise these rights, send your request to
confidentialite.s6_response_delay: We will respond within a maximum of 30 days.
confidentialite.s6_p2_pre: You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (French Data Protection Authority):
confidentialite.s7_p1: CYNA DEV implements appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss or disclosure: TLS encryption in transit, two-factor authentication (2FA), access logging, environment isolation.
confidentialite.s8_p1: The site only uses cookies that are strictly necessary for its operation (session, authentication). No advertising or third-party tracking cookies are used.
